reviewTitle: CIN-6E-A Final Operator-Approved Visual Production Lock

referencePolicy.rule: Judge every character independently against the canonical full sprite. Preserve face visibility or concealment, headwear, silhouette, proportions, palette, costume or armor family, weapons, accessories, and distinctive shapes. A character is masked only when the matching canonical sprite is masked.
referencePolicy.staticTableauRule: Static tableaux use the canonical runtime full sprites unchanged. Generated tableau assets are character-free backgrounds.
referencePolicy.operatorGate: Operator image and dynamic-video review complete. Pilots A-F are approved; E-C supersedes rejected E-A and E-B.

notes: E-A remains rejected because Kestrel lacks the canonical green cloth mask.
E-B remains rejected because Cedric lacks the canonical metal face mask.
E-C is the operator-approved replacement source and video.

pilots.name: Royal Audience Tableau
pilots.summary: Character-free audience backgrounds composited with unchanged canonical runtime sprites.

assets.reason: Character-free and compatible with the safe zones. Candidate B has a cleaner ground plane and stronger audience depth.
Character-free, coherent royal pavilion, clean foreground stage, and compatible with the canonical audience tableau.
Foreground cast comes directly from canonical full sprites; no generated character interpretation is present.
Responsive proof using the same unchanged canonical sprites.

pilots.name: Forest Road Cross-mode
pilots.summary: Forest family master, integrated Travel Still, and canonical-sprite tableau share one location identity.

assets.reason: Character-free forest-road identity suitable for cross-mode lineage.

Alistair retains the closed dark helm, red plume, greatsword, charcoal plate and red cape. Seraphine retains her visible face, cream hood, teal-and-gold robes and censer staff. Maelor retains his visible face, purple-and-gold court coat, book and dagger.
Static tableau uses unchanged canonical full sprites over a character-free background.
Responsive proof using the same unchanged canonical sprites.

pilots.name: Camp Continuous Shot
pilots.summary: Both integrated keyframes retain Marian's canonical closed white-and-gold face helm; they remain available for operator selection.

assets.reason: Marian correctly retains the closed white-and-gold slit helm, white and pale-blue ceremonial armor-robes, star-topped staff and light magic. Maelor and Alistair also retain their canonical identity features.
Marian's fully concealed face is faithful to full/marian.png. The alternate composition preserves the same three canonical identities and remains pending operator choice.

pilots.name: Second Refuge Tableau
pilots.summary: Character-free night refuge background with unchanged canonical runtime cast.

assets.reason: Generated layer is character-free; foreground identity is the canonical full-sprite cast.
Responsive proof using the same unchanged canonical sprites.

pilots.name: Cedric Encounter Transition
pilots.summary: E-C is the approved Cedric/Kestrel encounter source. E-A and E-B remain visible as rejected identity evidence.

assets.reason: Cedric retains the closed metal mask and paired blades; Kestrel retains the opaque green cloth mask, longbow, arrow and quiver.

Cedric retains the deep-purple hood, metal face mask, agile armored silhouette and paired curved blades. CIN-6E-A.2 found that Kestrel's source rendering exposes a human nose, mouth and jaw instead of the canonical green cloth mask; this selected source now requires operator revisit.
Cedric's canonical metal face mask disappears and a visible human lower face is introduced. This identity change is disqualifying.
Static tableau uses the exact canonical Kestrel and Cedric full sprites.
Responsive proof using the same unchanged canonical sprites.

assets.reason: Seraphine retains her visible face, cream hood, teal-and-gold robes, satchel and censer staff. Elara retains the pointed wide-brim hat, fully shadowed face with blue eyes, blue-gold robes, book and blue magic.
Static tableau uses unchanged canonical full sprites over a character-free background.
Responsive proof using the same unchanged canonical sprites.
